name: After § 5
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 5 a. Rejects any political instrumentalisation of rule-of-law conditionality leading to the withholding of funds from a Member State because it pursues policies aimed at protecting its borders and defending the family; considers that defending family values and protecting one’s people against illegal immigration, insecurity and the social tensions they generate should, on the contrary, be regarded as a fundamental right and become a shared objective of the Union;
